title: Author-route formula-unit cluster geometry and Raman validation
difficulty_reasons: The 38-atom formula-unit cluster requires a heavy-atom ECP/mixed-basis optimization, minimum validation and six mode assignments.
The comparison requires explicit atom/mode mapping and three aggregate metrics.

paper.title: A new multifunctional one-dimensional bromo-bismuthate(iii): synthesis, structural features, characterization, and optical properties of (C10H13N4)[BiBr4]·2H2O

data.description: SI-derived 38-atom neutral-singlet formula-unit cluster containing [BiBr4]-, the organic cation and two waters.
Six observed Raman bands and explicit direct Bi-Br/Br-Bi-Br pairings required by the v1 comparison.

required_deliverables.description: JSON report of provenance, optimized geometry, six frequencies, validation and comparison metrics.
